activity.message:
merge(init): complete workspace initialization

Merges docs/workspace-init into main with:
- GEMINI.md: workspace memory, communication rules, git standards
- README.md: public masterclass curriculum, .venv & menagerie setup
- docs/: documentation index and initial setup notes
- 6-phase folder structure (01_basics through 06_rl_and_gymnasium)
- requirements.txt: mujoco, numpy, matplotlib, scipy, gymnasium
- LICENSE: MIT
- Scripts reorganized into phase folders with relative path resolution

chore(init): add scipy & gymnasium to requirements, clarify external deps in README

- requirements.txt: add scipy (Phase 5 IK/optimization) and gymnasium
  (Phase 6 RL wrappers)
- README.md: visually separate tracked files from external/local-only
  dirs (mujoco_menagerie, .venv); add Step 4 to clone mujoco_menagerie
- Verified all imports: mujoco 3.11.0, numpy 2.5.1, scipy 1.18.0,
  gymnasium 1.3.0, matplotlib 3.11.1

refactor(workspace): organize scripts into phase folders and add project files

- Move hello_mujoco.py, load_robot.py → 01_basics/
- Move dog_pushups.py, robot_system.py → 02_actuation_and_control/
- Fix xml_path resolution in all moved scripts (os.path relative to script)
- Create placeholder dirs with .gitkeep: 03–06 phases
- Add requirements.txt (mujoco, numpy, matplotlib)
- Add MIT LICENSE
- Update README.md to reflect new folder structure and pip install -r

docs(workspace): add GEMINI.md, README.md, and docs/ for MuJoCo masterclass

- GEMINI.md: workspace memory with communication, documentation, git,
  and code quality guidelines; 6-phase learning roadmap; MuJoCo API reference
- README.md: public-facing beginner-to-advanced curriculum with .venv
  setup instructions and concepts cheatsheet
- docs/README.md: documentation index with table of contents
- docs/01_workspace_setup.md: initial architecture and setup notes

docs(ai): establish global AI guidelines for communication and git workflow

Defines strict rules for AI agents interacting with the repository, prioritizing explicit communication, professional documentation, and standardized git workflows (Conventional Commits).
chore: initialize professional repo structure with README and MIT License
docs: create master README as index and quick-start

build(devcontainer): separate mac and thinkpad hardware profiles

- Split single devcontainer.json into mac/ and thinkpad-gpu/ variants.

- Mac config explicitly skips Gazebo simulation and GPU passthrough for lightweight use.

- ThinkPad config installs Gazebo and passes NVIDIA GPU / X11 flags.

- Install 'agy' CLI dynamically via curl in Dockerfile to avoid large binaries in repo.

- Add .dockerignore to speed up build context transfers.

- Add ros2-shell.sh helper script for ThinkPad X11 terminals.
